goal: Prevent wallet in-memory state from desynchronizing with disk when database writes fail
Avoid silent data loss or corruption during key encryption, passphrase updates, and transactions
reviewability: Needs rebase due to merge conflicts with active wallet PRs
agreement: Concept approval because it ensures consistency between in-memory and disk state (rkrux, l0rinc)
Concern about partial in-memory updates on write failure versus treating corruption as fatal (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it addresses systematic data integrity and state synchronization risks in wallet persistence
Eliminates silent failure modes when updating passphrases or encrypting keys
